name: Last to Get Sick Wins
desc:
Do you have what it takes to not get sick? Put your immune system to the test and see if you can outlast everyone else 🚀

🛏️ Stay in the hospital bed to keep health
💎 Earn gems by infecting others, winning games, and by outlasting your opponents
💩 Troll everyone with funny abilities
🤒 Be the last healthy one
